entry.author: Te Whare Wānanga o Awanuiārangi
entry.summary:
In collaboration with Serco Asia Pacific this kōrero explores a journey of reflection, resilience, and self-discovery. It highlights the challenges that can arise when striving for positive change, while also recognising the strength it takes to keep moving forward.

Through learning and reflection, new perspectives can emerge, confidence can grow, and a deeper understanding of identity can be formed. While the journey may not always be easy, every step forward is a step worth celebrating.

A powerful reminder that growth can happen anywhere at any time.
